# glpi_network_name (Resource)

GLPI network name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "glpi_ip_network" "office" {
  name    = "Office"
  address = "192.168.50.0"
  netmask = "255.255.254.0"
}

resource "glpi_network_name" "printer_vlan" {
  name          = "printer-vlan"
  ip_network_id = glpi_ip_network.office.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the item.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `entity_id` (Number) ID of the entity that owns the item. 0 is the root entity.
- `ip_network_id` (Number) ID of the IP network.
- `item_id` (Number) ID of the item that owns the network name.
- `item_type` (String) GLPI itemtype of the item that owns the network name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) GLPI numeric ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by GLPI numeric ID.
terraform import glpi_network_name.example 42
```
